title: True Blue Account: Dedicated Support and Response Times
summary: This document explains True Blue Account dedicated support, including a guaranteed first response within 1 business hour, what to include in your request (account name, last four digits, issue description, transaction IDs/payment references), and escalation if unresolved within that window. It also notes $0.00 per-transaction cash deposit fee and that support can confirm recent deposits, investigate discrepancies, and provide deposit confirmation documentation.
